newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK unveils expressway link to future airport.
newsitem.headline: HK unveils expressway link to future airport.

text.p: Hong Kong on Thursday unveiled a new expressway to link the future Chek Lap Kok airport to urban areas in the territory.

The 12.5 km (eight mile) North Lantau Expressway, which runs along the northern coast of Lantau island, is part of an ambitious transport project which will carry passengers to the new airport due to be opened in April 1998.
The complete road link to the new airport from Hong Kong Island will be open to traffic next month, Secretary for Works H.S. Kwong told reporters.
The US$20.3 billion airport complex is being built on reclaimed land off Lantau and billed as the world's most expensive.
Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule in July after more than 150 years of British rule.
